verdict.rationale: Firebase docs state that upgrading to Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform unlocks multi-factor authentication, SAML and generic OpenID Connect support, plus multi-tenancy. This is first-party, but it depends on a paid upgrade and appears only as a one-line feature mention. Missing for 10: evidence that MFA and SSO can be enforced (required) for all users, detailed setup docs for SAML/OIDC providers, availability on the base Firebase Auth tier without the Identity Platform upgrade, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
